reviews.text: We attended the puppy classes run by Antonella and Claudia and highly recommend to any new owners. They were great teachers and helped us to understand the best ways to train our puppy, who loved attending each session. The group was really well run and they made sure to offer us individual feedback based on our puppy's needs. Simon was really responsive on email with any queries and the WhatsApp to talk with other owners and Antonella and Claudia outside of class really useful. We look forward to attending the immediate classes in the future.

I brought a puppy that was scared & Unsure of everything to the classes and can proudly say after 4 weeks he is 100% more confident , learnt so much and is in a much better position to deal with other dogs . We as a family also learnt so much more about him and how best to help him settle down in his new home. Highly recommend

I cannot recommend Antonella and her team highly enough. Our pup has come through the beginner puppy school and now we go regularly to intermediate classes. The team at AWC helped us to realise that training is less about teaching tricks and more about understanding our dog’s behaviour in the context of his own complex social system and worldview. This understanding has made us better owners, and in turn created a happier pup! The prices are also so reasonable; we came across plenty of trainers who were nowhere near as qualified, who charged significantly more.

Antonella has been fantastic to work with. She strikes the perfect balance between professionalism, expertise and a wonderful sense of humour, making every session enjoyable as well as incredibly informative.

She took the time to understand Milo and tailored her advice to his needs. After each session, she followed up with clear guides, helpful videos and practical exercises, making it easy to build our confidence and continue the training at home.

Her positive, compassionate approach has made a real difference, and we’re already seeing great progress with Milo. We always came away from our sessions feeling encouraged, supported and motivated.

If you’re looking for a knowledgeable, kind and genuinely engaging behaviourist, we couldn’t recommend Antonella more highly. Thank you for helping both Milo and us!

We highly recommend Antonella. She was pragmatic, knowledgeable, and took the time to understand our situation as a whole rather than focusing on isolated behaviours.

She helped us better understand how to communicate with our cocker spaniel, Ruby, and how to recognise Ruby’s communication with us. The changes she suggested to our routine have had a hugely positive impact, and her ongoing support—including reviewing videos, phone calls, and providing reassurance—was invaluable.

Most importantly, she helped build our confidence as owners, which in turn helped Ruby become more confident. Our bond with Ruby has improved enormously, and everyone is much happier as a result. We are incredibly grateful for Antonella’s support and would not hesitate to recommend her.
Amazing dynamic between the trainer and behaviourist and a really well organised set up with attention split well between all dogs in the class. Highly recommend

Highly recommend Antonella!

She was really understanding and she worked her magic on our reactive bulldog, couldn’t have asked for someone better.

We were recommended to this amazing puppy class by three different people whose pups had done it as well! Safe to say, it was the best recommendation! Antonella, Claudia, and Simon were FANTASTIC! Our little Katya learned so much and gained so much confidence over the sessions. It was clear the other little pups did as well! Outside of class, they are always happy to answer questions and check on progress. People always remark what a well behaved little one she is for her age and I fully credit the team with giving us the tools to make her thrive. Thank you so much and if I could give more than 5 stars I would! ❤️
